ownership.quote: Runloop, the only enterprise-grade infrastructure platform that enables the development, evaluation and scalable deployment of AI coding agents, announced today that it has raised a $7M seed round led by The General Partnership with participation from Blank Ventures.

stage.quote: Runloop ... announced today that it has raised a $7M seed round led by The General Partnership with participation from Blank Ventures.
stage.note: Only publicly disclosed round to date is this $7M seed (July 2025); no later round found as of 2026-09-30. Checked ycombinator.com/companies/runloop (404, not a YC company).

total_funding_usd.basis: Only disclosed round is the $7M seed per PR Newswire press release, matching Ry Walker Research's company profile ($7M Seed, July 2025).
total_funding_usd.quote: Runloop Raises $7M Seed Round to Bring Enterprise-Grade Infrastructure to AI Coding Agents

last_round.quote: SAN FRANCISCO, July 30, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Runloop ... announced today that it has raised a $7M seed round led by The General Partnership with participation from Blank Ventures.

note: Founded 2024 by Jonathan Wall (co-founder of Google Wallet and fintech Index, which was acquired by Stripe) and a team of ex-Stripe developers, headquartered in San Francisco. Raised a $7M seed round (July 2025) led by The General Partnership with Blank Ventures participating; no later priced round disclosed as of 2026-09-30. Not a Y Combinator company (ycombinator.com/companies/runloop returns 404).
